sources.title: LGMG Serial Number Query
sources.notes: Public entry has PIN input; result headings Number, Model, Description, View More. No manufacturing-year field or year decode rule verified. No private serial submitted.

sources.title: LGMG Product Series parts search
sources.notes: Public model/standard selector successfully returned CE S0607E parts-catalog ranges without authentication. Deeper linked EPC application is JavaScript-rendered and was not fully tested. Do not label whole EPC public or account-only solely from this test.

research_limitations: No universal brand-wide decoder is established for either manufacturer.
Some Sinoboom PDF downloads exceeded the web reader size limit; exact official URLs were downloaded successfully and locally rendered for verification.

LGMG North America Gen1 operation manual at https://www.lgmgna.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/Slab-scissor-Gen1-Operation-Safety-Manual-2022-09-30.pdf returned HTTP 403. Search snippets were not treated as sufficient plate/decoder evidence.
Marketplace serial/year pairings and third-party manual mirrors were excluded as date-rule evidence.
LGMG publicly linked EPC returned a JavaScript application shell; no login attempted and no claim is made about full catalog access requirements.
